scripts.check: oxlint && oxfmt --write && ! git grep -nIP --untracked '\x{2014}' -- ':!apps/web/AGENTS.md' && ! git grep -nIP --untracked '[^\s\d(] - [^\s\d)]' -- 'apps/server/src/chat/prompts/*.md' 'apps/server/src/chat/skills/*.md'
scripts.check-types: tsc-rs --noEmit && tsc-rs --noEmit -p apps/mobile && tsc-rs --noEmit -p apps/sandbox && tsc-rs --noEmit -p apps/data && bun run --filter web check-types
scripts.db:crawl: bun run env scripts/fatwas.ts && bun run env scripts/dedupeFatwas.ts --apply && bun run env scripts/embed.ts && bun run env scripts/searchVersion.ts
